name: A temple song
about: Composed for this atlas in the manner of the songs to the gods (teocuicatl) that Sahagún's Nahua informants describe being sung to the huehuetl and teponaztli: short phrases repeated and raised, on five notes (here D, F, G, A, C), the conch sounding beneath. No melody of the Mexica survives; clay flutes give the nearest notes.
